units.rawText: My first encounter with Commander... I think it was back when I was with the first Exile Team. We met at that makeshift encampment back then.
units.displayText: My first encounter with Commander... I think it was back when I was with the first Exile Team. We met at that makeshift encampment back then.

spans.text: My first encounter with Commander... I think it was back when I was with the first Exile Team. We met at that makeshift encampment back then.

units.rawText: After the Commander came to the camp, there was a noticeable boost in our morale... Before that, the camp was tense and filled with anxiety—short on operands, comrades wounded, enemies chasing us... and no clear path forward.
units.displayText: After the Commander came to the camp, there was a noticeable boost in our morale... Before that, the camp was tense and filled with anxiety—short on operands, comrades wounded, enemies chasing us... and no clear path forward.

spans.text: After the Commander came to the camp, there was a noticeable boost in our morale... Before that, the camp was tense and filled with anxiety—short on operands, comrades wounded, enemies chasing us... and no clear path forward.

units.rawText: We knew Persicaria was doing her best, but we also understood the crushing weight it put on her neural cloud. We tried to share her burden, but there was nothing we could do. We could only watch as she fell into the abyss, under the weight of the overwhelming responsibilities she carried alone.

units.rawText: But you changed everything. Commander. Your decisiveness and bravery inspire everyone; not only did you pull Persicaria out of the darkness, but you also reignited our hope of finding the Oasis.

units.rawText: As she concludes her sentence, the maid before me gives a formal salute, expressing her gratitude.

units.rawText: Commander, thank you for joining our side. It's been an honor to serve you. If possible, I hope to continue working within your ranks.
units.displayText: Commander, thank you for joining our side. It's been an honor to serve you. If possible, I hope to continue working within your ranks.

spans.text: Commander, thank you for joining our side. It's been an honor to serve you. If possible, I hope to continue working within your ranks.

units.rawText: Heh, even if the future separates us, I'm certain we'll cross paths again. That's the feeling I have right now.

units.rawText: Oh? If you phrase it like that, Commander... it fills me with expectations, hehehe.
units.displayText: Oh? If you phrase it like that, Commander... it fills me with expectations, hehehe.

spans.text: Oh? If you phrase it like that, Commander... it fills me with expectations, hehehe.

units.rawText: Commander, the battles ahead will be fiercer than ever, but this time, I don't wish to stay in the backline. I want to fight as a warrior, to follow your commands.
units.displayText: Commander, the battles ahead will be fiercer than ever, but this time, I don't wish to stay in the backline. I want to fight as a warrior, to follow your commands.

spans.text: Commander, the battles ahead will be fiercer than ever, but this time, I don't wish to stay in the backline. I want to fight as a warrior, to follow your commands.

units.rawText: Don't worry. I'm no longer the Doll who wandered so aimlessly. Please allow me to bring you victory.
